tool.name: nf-core shasta
tool.description: The goal of the Shasta long read assembler is to rapidly produce accurate assembled sequence using DNA reads generated by Oxford Nanopore flow cells as input. Please note Assembler is design to focus on speed, so assembly may be considered somewhat non-deterministic as final assembly may vary across executions. See https://github.com/chanzuckerberg/shasta/issues/296.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ # shasta requires uncompressed zcat -f $reads > reads.fq
# run shasta shasta \\ --input reads.fq \\ --config $model \\ $args \\ --threads $task.cpus
# compress results gzip -c ShastaRun/Assembly.fasta > ${prefix}_Assembly.fasta.gz gzip -c ShastaRun/Assembly.gfa > ${prefix}_Assembly.gfa.gz
# cleanup temp files rm reads.fq
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": shasta: \$(shasta --version | head -n 1 | cut -f 3 -d " ") END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
The goal of the Shasta long read assembler is to rapidly produce accurate assembled sequence using DNA reads generated by Oxford Nanopore flow cells as input. Please note Assembler is design to focus on speed, so assembly may be considered somewhat non-deterministic as final assembly may vary across executions. See https://github.com/chanzuckerberg/shasta/issues/296.
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: shasta Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/shasta ]]>
